won_reason: Fast trust-building with founder + flexible contract structure

calls.notes: Meera reached out after seeing our case study on a D2C brand. Team of 18 sales reps, no CRM — tracking on Excel sheets. Losing track of repeat customers. Founder Arjun involved in day-to-day sales still. Timeline: needed something running before Diwali season (Oct 20).

Demo with Meera + Arjun. Arjun came in skeptical — had tried Zoho 2 years ago, bad implementation experience. We addressed this head-on: showed our 14-day onboarding guarantee in writing. He asked about WhatsApp integration for customer follow-ups — we demoed it live. Mood shifted.
red_flags: founder has prior bad CRM experience

calls.notes: Pricing call. Arjun pushed back on annual commitment — startup, cash flow tight. We offered quarterly billing at a 10% premium. He accepted immediately. Also agreed to be a reference customer in exchange for a 5% discount. Deal signed same day.

lessons_learned: Addressing prior bad vendor experience head-on = trust accelerator
14-day onboarding guarantee in writing removed biggest objection
Live WhatsApp demo hit the exact emotional need — turned the founder
Flexible billing structure (quarterly) unlocked a cash-strapped founder
Reference customer deal is a win-win — discount for social proof
Tight timeline was urgency, not a red flag — lean into it
